resolution: The follow-up live data confirmed the console-owner self-noise no longer appears: spike reports now say no recent recon owner records, which is the honest state for these no-React REPAINT/GLYPH events. The remaining unsolved lane is a host-side 2D draw-data hash flip without a React commit owner. I therefore extended host telemetry to expose per-buffer hashes in __tel_gpu so the next run can distinguish text vs rect vs curve/capsule/polygon churn in the changed-across-spike line. This is diagnostic instrumentation, not a timing mask or data rewrite. Build and game verify are green; live confirmation remains needed for the next attribution.
